# FG-INT-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`webhook-delivery`](../../ops/runbooks/webhook-delivery.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_delivery_out_of_attempts_is_int_0004` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Webhook の配信が再試行の上限まで失敗しました。配信の履歴を確かめ、受信先を直してから再送してください。
- en: A webhook delivery failed on every retry. Check the delivery history, fix the receiver, then redeliver.
- id: Pengiriman webhook gagal pada setiap percobaan ulang. Periksa riwayat pengiriman, perbaiki penerima, lalu kirim ulang.

## 原因 (cause)

One delivery (one event to one webhook) failed on its last attempt: forge-integ's `webhook.deliver` job tried it `attempts` times (at most 10, backoff 10 s × 4^(n−1) up to 4 h, about 16 h in all) and every attempt failed — the receiver answered a status other than 2xx (a redirect is never followed and counts as a failure), refused or timed out the connection (3 s connect, 10 s in all), failed TLS, the name did not resolve, or the target is no longer allowed. The delivery's row is `state = failed` with the last status and reason; nothing is retried by itself after this. Not an alert: the receiver is outside forge, and the event stays readable in the integration feed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `webhook_id`, `delivery_id` (the Forge-Delivery value), `event_id`, `event_type`, `attempts`, `last_status` (or `none`), `last_reason` (`status`, `redirect`, `connect`, `connect_timeout`, `timeout`, `tls`, `body`, `request`, `dns`, `target_forbidden`) and `origin` (scheme://host:port only, never the path or query). `gstn webhook deliveries <webhook_id> --project <id>` (or GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/webhooks/{webhook_id}/deliveries) lists them; SELECT state, attempts, last_status, last_reason, last_error_code FROM forge.webhook_deliveries WHERE delivery_uid = '<delivery_id>'.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook webhook-delivery: make the receiver answer 2xx within 10 s at the configured URL (no redirect), check that `webhook.allowed_targets` still names it, then redeliver (`gstn webhook redeliver <webhook_id> <delivery_id> --project <id>`, a Maintainer). A receiver that missed many events reads them from the integration feed instead.
